visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back in a bun and wearing a cozy gray sweater sits at a light-colored wooden table next to a man in a dark gray zip-up hoodie. She holds a large plastic cup filled with milk tea and dark boba pearls, featuring a thick pink straw. She takes a slow sip from the straw, eyes closed, in a brightly lit indoor home setting featuring white walls and green indoor plants in the background. (2) The man turns his head toward the woman, speaking directly to her while she continues to hold the beverage. She looks back at him with a slight, friendly smile and then begins to move the plastic cup across the wooden tabletop. She uses her right hand to extend the drink toward him, offering it for him to try. (3) The camera cuts to a much closer shot focusing specifically on the man as he interacts with the beverage. He picks up the cup with one hand, examines the liquid and pearls curiously for a brief moment, and then takes a long, deliberate sip through the pink straw. He glances off-camera with a neutral, thoughtful expression as he swallows the drink. (4) The shot returns to the original medium view showing the couple together again. The man finishes his sip, nods his head in approval, and hands the cup back to the woman. She takes another sip of the bubble tea herself while they exchange small smiles and brief words, and the entire scene eventually fades into black.
